criterion: which general domain of assistant use the utterance belongs to

categories.name: Travel & Navigation
categories.definition: Planning trips, asking about destinations, travel advisories, flight status, directions, local points of interest, transportation, finding hotels, or current location awareness.

categories.name: Finance & Banking
categories.definition: Managing bank accounts, credit cards, loans, bills, payments, financial information, fraud, and related inquiries.

categories.name: Personal Organization & Scheduling
categories.definition: Managing personal calendars, reminders, to-do lists, appointments, and personal reservations.

categories.name: General Information & Knowledge
categories.definition: Asking factual questions, definitions, conversions, recipes, trivia, weather, general advice, or how-to instructions.

categories.name: Device & Assistant Settings
categories.definition: Changing the assistant's voice, language, volume, modes, or resetting its configuration, or connecting to other devices.

categories.name: Assistant Self-Referential
categories.definition: Questions about the assistant's identity, capabilities, origin, or personal attributes.

categories.name: Shopping & Purchases
categories.definition: Creating shopping lists, asking about items to buy, making direct purchases, or checking shipping status.

categories.name: Media & Entertainment
categories.definition: Playing music, identifying songs, asking for jokes, or general entertainment content.

categories.name: Communication
categories.definition: Making calls, sending messages, or sharing location with others.

categories.name: Home Automation & Smart Devices
categories.definition: Controlling smart home devices or appliances.

categories.name: Customer Service & General Reservations
categories.definition: Asking about wait times, reviews, or making reservations for non-personal entities like restaurants or businesses.

categories.name: Finding Lost Items
categories.definition: Locating personal items like phones or luggage.

categories.name: General Interaction/Conversational
categories.definition: Utterances that are conversational fillers, acknowledgements, simple requests for repetition, greetings, or non-task-specific responses.
